newsitem.title: USA: Motorola to restate '95 earnings, EPS rises.
newsitem.headline: Motorola to restate '95 earnings, EPS rises.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Tuesday it agreed to restate its 1995 financial statements, increasing its fully diluted earnings per share to $3.37 from $2.93.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Motorola said it will record a gain of about $400 million in the third quarter of 1995 from the sale of a business to Nextel Communications Inc. Fourth quarter 1995 will include a realized loss of about $133 million, recognizing the decline in the Nextel share price.
Motorola's 1995 pretax earnings will increase to $3.225 billion from $2.782 billion.

In July 1995, Motorola sold its U.S. 800 megahertz Specialized Mobile Radio business, systems and licenses to Nextel for shares of Nextel stock and accounted for the sale as an exchange of productive assets with no gain realized.
But the SEC said Motorola should have recognized a gain at the time of the transaction.

"After discussion with the SEC, the company has agreed to restate the 1995 financial statements to reflect the accounting treatment proposed by the SEC and currently is discussing the restatement with the SEC," Motorola said.
Other than "minor reclassifications" to stockholders' equity, the restatement does not affect the company's consolidated balance sheet, Motorola said.
Motorola said it expects to file the restatement with the SEC in the very near future.
